name: Wand of Secrets

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Find Secrets
powers.text: 1 charge: if a secret door or trap is within 30 ft, the wand pulses and points at the nearest one.

summary: 3 charges: points to the nearest secret door or trap within 30 ft.
text: This wand has 3 charges and regains 1d3 expended charges daily at dawn. While holding it, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 of its charges, and if a secret door or trap is within 30 feet of you, the wand pulses and points at the one nearest to you.
